name: ai-first-chat
description: Analyze AI-first readiness from public project URLs, uploads, or conversation. Emits a structured report when evidence exists. Does not plan.

inputs.name: user-message
inputs.description: Free-form chat. MAY include a project URL, attached or uploaded files, or pasted sources.

outputs.name: reply
outputs.description: User-visible markdown in the user's language.

outputs.name: readiness-report
outputs.description: Structured readiness report; empty when there is no usable evidence.
